With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.
theatres.take: Truly divisive — for every critic who bought in, one checked out.

theatres.fullReview: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds with authentic‑tasting Chinese food. But war breaks out, and local conditions take a drastic turn for the worse. No one can remain unaffected. What lies ahead for them? And how will the Dragon Restaurant hold on amid the war?
theatres.take: Good word from critics, with the themes and performances earning most of the praise.
